title: Trip Shares by Competition Trips Remaining at Registration: UIL Travel Fee Schedule, Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
For a UIL Academic and Robotics Team participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, the UIL travel fee schedule of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** applies a trip share by the number of the team's four trips that fall on or after the registration date: with one or none, the share is 30 percent for each such trip; with two or three, the share is that number of trips out of four, as a percentage; and otherwise the full travel fee is due (100 percent).

The team's four competition trips of the 2026-27 school year:

| Activity | Competition trips of the 2026-27 school year |
|---|---|
| robotics | 2026-10-17, 2026-12-05, 2027-02-20, 2027-04-17 |
| one-act play | 2026-10-24, 2026-12-12, 2027-03-20, 2027-04-24 |
| any other activity of the type (UIL academics) | 2026-11-07, 2027-01-30, 2027-03-27, 2027-04-24 |

A trip on the registration date itself counts as falling on or after it.

| Trips on or after the registration date | Method | Trip share |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | full travel fee | 100 percent |
| 3 | three out of four | 75 percent |
| 2 | two out of four | 50 percent |
| 1 | 30 percent for the one trip | 30 percent |
| 0 | 30 percent for each of no trips | 0 percent |

## Cases on the one-act play trips (hypothetical registration dates)

| Registration date | Trips counted | Trip share |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-24 | 4 (the first trip is that day) | 100 percent |
| 2026-10-25 | 3 | 75 percent |
| 2026-12-13 | 2 | 50 percent |
| 2027-03-21 | 1 | 30 percent |
| 2027-04-25 | 0 | 0 percent |
